## Biography

Abel Embaye is Clinical Associate Professor of Economics at the University of Arkansas. His research interests include public finance, labor economics and African economies..

## Education

{{< fa graduation-cap >}} PhD in Economics, Georgia State University, 2007


{{< fa graduation-cap >}} MA in Economics, Tilburg University, 1999

{{< fa graduation-cap >}}  BA in Economics, Asmara University, 1995

## Research Interests 

- Public Finance

- Labor Economics

- African Economies
